request.query: cardinality of finitely supported functions restricted to a finite set and finite coefficient sets

items.name: Cardinal.mk_finsupp_lift_of_fintype
items.type:
∀ (α : Type u) (β : Type v) [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Zero β],
  Cardinal.mk (α →₀ β) = Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (Cardinal.mk β) ^ Fintype.card α

items.name: DFinsupp.card_pi
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → Zero (α i)] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (α i)] (f : Π₀ (i : ι), Finset (α i)), f.pi.card = f.prod fun i => ↑(f i).card

items.name: Fintype.card_finsupp
items.type:
∀ (ι : Type u_1) (α : Type u_2) [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : Zero α] [inst_3 : Fintype α],
  Fintype.card (ι →₀ α) = Fintype.card α ^ Fintype.card ι

items.name: Finset.card_dfinsupp
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → Zero (α i)] (s : Finset ι)
  (t : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)), (s.dfinsupp t).card = ∏ i ∈ s, (t i).card

items.name: Finset.finsupp
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} → {α : Type u_2} → [inst : Zero α] → Finset ι → (ι → Finset α) → Finset (ι →₀ α)
